# Decap CMS 3.16.3

Self-hosted browser distribution from `npm pack decap-cms@3.16.3`.
Upstream: https://github.com/decaporg/decap-cms (MIT).
The browser bundle's third-party notices are in `decap-cms.js.LICENSE.txt`.
Only `/admin/` loads these assets; public blog pages do not download the CMS.
Keep the entry file, chunk files and WASM files from the same release together.
